reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code, promo_name, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE discount_pct BETWEEN 10 AND 20
alternatives:
SELECT promo_code, promo_name, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE discount_pct >= 10
  AND discount_pct <= 20

SELECT promo_code, promo_name, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE discount_pct BETWEEN 10.00 AND 20.00

other_way.sql:
SELECT promo_code, promo_name, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE discount_pct >= 10
  AND discount_pct <= 20
other_way.tradeoff: Two comparisons give the same rows, but BETWEEN states the range in one short test.
